tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250yang gter yakṣa dzam bha la'i gter srung mchod thabs ni/ mchod gtor 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ 1$0000300hūm̐/ snang srid zil gnon padma thod phreng gi /bka' nyan snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ khyad par gter srung brag btsan 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs rang mthun gdan la dgyes par bzhugs// phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka ba lingta// dgra bgegs sha khrag la sogs mkho dgu'i rdzas// zag med nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor 'bul// mi mthun nyams chag thugs 'gal nongs pa bshags// snang srid ro mnyam chen por dam bsre na// 'bral med rdo rje'i tha tshig rjes dgongs te// bdag cag sgrub mchog rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel// gang bcol rnam bzhi'i las kun 'grub par mdzod//

ces gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul lo// 'di yang bslab gsum ldan pa bla ma phan bde lags kyi bzhed ngor bi dza yas (zhe chen rgyal tshab )gang dran smras pa dge// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
